title: How the web moves a message
audience: developers who never took a networking class
world: a laptop called LAPPY talking to a server called SHELF across the internet. Cast: LAPPY (the laptop), SHELF (the server), the DNS BOOK (an address book), the POSTMAN (who carries packets). Keep the same four characters in every lecture.

lectures.title: What really happens when you type a URL
lectures.point: the DNS book turns the name into an address, TCP opens a road, and HTTP carries the message both ways

lectures.title: Why HTTPS is more than a lock icon
lectures.point: TLS shakes hands, checks a certificate, and only then scrambles the road so middlemen see noise
